name: Stablecoin market-cap growth surge -> demand nowcast (BTC/ETH, mcap not flow)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the net-flow variant: this reads the STOCK growth of stablecoin_mcap rather than the exchange net-flow rate — a smoother, less exchange-visibility-dependent measure of fresh fiat entering the perimeter, capturing on-chain mint supply that has NOT necessarily hit an exchange yet): expanding total stablecoin market cap is capital freshly parked in the crypto perimeter that must eventually be deployed into a risk asset. Rising stablecoin_mcap growth is a leading demand nowcast independent of where the coins currently sit. Entry: stablecoin_mcap above a fitted growth threshold AND price not already extended (range_position below a ceiling, so we buy demand before the top). Hold 4-14d. DISCONFIRMER 1: mcap growth is smooth and may lag price -> KILL if it is coincident with, not leading, forward returns (require positive predictive coefficient at k>=1 after BH-FDR). DISCONFIRMER 2: if net-flow (variant 04) and mcap growth give the same result they are one spec; the stock measure must add distinct information. DISCONFIRMER 3: supply that funds arb collateral not spot longs is the null. Must clear DSR>=0.95 net of fees, beat buy-and-hold.
catalyst: expanding stablecoin market cap signaling fresh fiat demand
